default.description: The console window, and only it. The login webview is absent from every capability, so no command resolves for it, and that absence is the whole fence. It is not that a marketplace page has no bridge: Tauri injects the IPC internals into every webview it creates regardless of URL (tauri 2.11.5, src/manager/webview.rs:166-200), and app.withGlobalTauri adds window.__TAURI__ on top of them. What a page at a marketplace origin lacks is permission, because its window label is not main and nothing here grants it anything.
